summary: Kanzhun Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Exchange announcement of a routine employee equity grant under its Post-IPO Share Scheme. On September 15, 2026, the company granted 530,630 RSUs, representing an equal number of Class A ordinary shares, to nine employees at nil issue price, against a HK$60.2 closing share price. Vesting is time- and performance-based, with roughly 81.83% subject to performance evaluation and clawback provisions applying. No board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation transaction is involved; this is ordinary compensation disclosure, not a deal event.
